name: google-agent-assist-accelerator
description: Enterprise integration layer for Google Agent Assist

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d redis && concurrently -n redis,connector,ui,sidecar -c blue,yellow,green,magenta "docker compose logs -f redis" "cd services/ui-connector && source .venv/bin/activate && python main.py" "cd services/ui && npm run dev" "cd services/sidecar && npm run dev"
